name: PrimalDevs Payment Gateway for SecurePay for WooCommerce
author: Priyank Sukhadiya

sections.description:
The PrimalDevs Payment Gateway for SecurePay for WooCommerce is the ultimate solution for WooCommerce stores looking to offer secure, reliable, and fast credit card payment processing.

Use of 3rd Party Service

This plugin relies on the SecurePay payment gateway to process credit card transactions. When using this plugin, your store’s payment data is securely transmitted to SecurePay via a POST request, with a response indicating the success or failure of the transaction.

Details:

  • The plugin sends payment data (including credit card information and billing details) to the SecurePay API.
  • The API processes the data and returns a response indicating whether the transaction was successful.

Please ensure that your use of this plugin complies with any applicable legal requirements in your region for transmitting data to a third party.

For more information, review SecurePay’s policies:

  • SecurePay Website
  • SecurePay Privacy Policy
  • SecurePay Terms and Conditions

Requirements

  • Active SecurePay account.
  • WooCommerce version 3.3 or later.
  • A valid SSL certificate is required to ensure your customers’ credit card details are safe and to make your site PCI DSS compliant. This plugin does not store customer credit card numbers or sensitive information on your website.

Why SecurePay?

SecurePay is a leading payment gateway provider recognized for its robust and secure payment solutions. With this plugin, you can optimize your payment processing with PCI-compliant security features, fraud prevention tools, and a reliable infrastructure that enhances customer trust.

Key Features:

  • Secure Payment Processing: Fully PCI-compliant integration ensures that all transactions are secure and meet the highest security standards.
  • SecurePay Platform Integration: Leverage the powerful SecurePay payment gateway for seamless credit card processing and real-time transaction management.
  • Efficient Transaction Handling: Provides fast and reliable processing for Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and other credit card types.
  • Multiple Currency Support: Process payments in different currencies to cater to global customers.
  • Test and Live Mode: Easily switch between test and live environments to ensure your gateway is properly configured.
  • Enhanced Security: Emphasize PCI compliance for increased visibility in security-related searches.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the ‘wc-primaldevs-payment-gateway-securepay’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and select SecurePay Gateway.
  4. Configure the required parameters, including your SecurePay account credentials.
  5. Enable Test Mode to test transactions, and switch to Live Mode when you’re ready for production.
sections.faq:
What is the SecurePay payment gateway?

SecurePay is a leading payment processor that offers secure, fast, and reliable credit card transactions for online businesses.

How do I set up SecurePay with WooCommerce?

Once the plugin is installed, enter your SecurePay account credentials and configure settings in the WooCommerce payment gateway section. You can toggle between test and live modes for easy setup.

Is SSL Required?

Yes, a valid SSL certificate is required to ensure secure transactions and PCI DSS compliance.

1.1.0

  • Updated plugin for WordPress 6.9 compatibility
  • Removed deprecated load_plugin_textdomain() function call (WordPress handles this automatically since version 4.6)
  • Improved plugin name compliance by removing “WC” from display name while maintaining slug compatibility
  • Code optimization and performance improvements
  • Enhanced security and compatibility updates

1.0.0

  • Initial release of the PrimalDevs Payment Gateway for SecurePay for WooCommerce plugin.
  • SecurePay gateway integration with support for credit card transactions.
